kurals.tr: Ninaiththondru Sollaayo Nenje Enaiththondrum / Evvanoi Theerkkum Marundhu
kurals.m: O my soul, will you not think and tell me some medicine be it what it may, that can cure this incurable malady?

kurals.tr: Kaadhal Avarilar Aakanee Novadhu / Pedhaimai Vaazhiyen Nenju
kurals.m: Is folly, fare thee well my heart!

kurals.tr: Irundhulli Enparidhal Nenje Parindhullal / Paidhalnoi Seydhaarkan Il
kurals.m: O my soul! why remain (here) and suffer thinking (of him)? There are no lewd thoughts (of you) in him who has caused you this disease of sorrow

kurals.tr: Kannum Kolachcheri Nenje Ivaiyennaith / Thinnum Avarkkaanal Utru
kurals.m: O my soul! take my eyes also with you, (if not), these would eat me up (in their desire) to see him

kurals.tr: Setraar Enakkai Vitalunto Nenjeyaam / Utraal Uraaa Thavar
kurals.m: O my soul! can he who loves not though he is beloved, be forsaken saying he hates me (now)?

kurals.tr: Kalandhunarththum Kaadhalark Kantaar Pulandhunaraai / Poikkaaivu Kaaidhien Nenju
kurals.m: O my soul! when you see the dear one who remove dislike by intercourse, you are displeased and continue to be so Nay, your displeasure is (simply) false

kurals.tr: Kaamam Vituondro Naanvitu Nannenje / Yaano Poreniv Virantu
kurals.m: O my good soul, give up either lust or honour, as for me I can endure neither

kurals.tr: Parindhavar Nalkaarendru Engip Pirindhavar / Pinselvaai Pedhaien Nenju
kurals.m: You are a fool, O my soul! to go after my departed one, while you mourn that he is not kind enough to favour you

kurals.tr: Ullaththaar Kaadha Lavaraal Ullinee / Yaaruzhaich Cheriyen Nenju
kurals.m: O my soul! to whom would you repair, while the dear one is within yourself?

kurals.tr: Thunnaath Thurandhaarai Nenjaththu Utaiyemaa / Innum Izhaththum Kavin
kurals.m: If I retain in my heart him who has left me without befriending me, I shall lose even the (inward) beauty that remains
